query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, based only on the search results provided. No sources were found for executive hires.

**Caveat on the top story:** A 15 November report says a company "has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion," citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). The snippet does not name the target. I could not confirm that it is Databricks, so verify this before the meeting.

## Products and launches
- On 11 November 2026, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents).
- An updated Genie can handle multi-step jobs that take extended time to complete (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-d5ce8d4f2e7d567c6d43a125_databricks-_genie_gives).
- The new agentic tools run in the background, shadow office workers, and make proactive suggestions. A separate "Ontology" feature scans organizational data (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html).

## Facilities and headcount
- Databricks opened its new headquarters at One Sansome in San Francisco, spanning 10 floors and over 200,000 sq ft. It plans to double headcount by 2027 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/databricks-san-francisco-headquarters-ai-office-22525207.php).

## Partners and ecosystem
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, a planned governed-data solution. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions, and it is not yet generally available (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai).

## Financials and listing
- As of late October, Databricks had no announced IPO date and no public S-1. Its private valuation was reported at $190 billion, with annualized revenue above $7 billion (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options).

## Hires and other gaps
- No executive hires were found in the search results.
- A company profile lists M&A dated 2025 to August 2026, including Electric DB Inc. (2026-08-01) and Panther Labs (2026-06-01). None falls within the 30-day window, and the profile is undated (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX).

## Open questions
1. Is Databricks the company in the reported $9.4 billion Globex acquisition, and if so, what is the status and expected closing timeline?
2. How will governed access work across third-party agents such as ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot, and what is the rollout timing for the Genie One MCP server?
3. Where will the planned headcount doubling by 2027 happen, which roles are growing, and how does that fit with the IPO timing?
